families.name: INFORMATION THEORY
entries: - Entropy table - rows=outcomes, cols=probabilities, bits - examples: alphabet coding, uncertainty budget
- Channel capacity table - rows=channels, cols=bandwidth, bits/sec - examples: modem specs, telemetry budget
- Codebook table - rows=symbols, cols=codewords, lengths - examples: huffman tables, morse code
- Rate-distortion table - rows=rates, cols=distortions - examples: jpeg quality, audio bitrate
- Mutual information table - rows=variables, cols=targets, bits - examples: feature relevance, sensor fusion
- Typewriter channel table - rows=input, cols=output, confusion - examples: keypads, typo models
- Redundancy table - rows=encodings, cols=overhead - examples: ecc memory, parity disks
- KL divergence table - rows=distributions, cols=references, nats - examples: drift monitoring, model comparison

families.name: GAME THEORY
entries: - Payoff matrix - rows=player A actions, cols=player B actions, utilities - examples: prisoner's dilemma, pricing wars
- Best response table - rows=opponent actions, cols=own actions, flags - examples: rock-paper-scissors, auctions
- Nash table - rows=strategy profiles, cols=deviation checks - examples: traffic equilibria, markets
- Zero-sum table - rows=maximin, cols=minimax, values - examples: matching pennies, poker ranges
- Extensive form table - rows=nodes, cols=actions, owners - examples: chess openings, negotiation trees
- Auction table - rows=bidder, cols=valuation, bid - examples: ad slots, spectrum sales
- Cooperative table - rows=coalitions, cols=value - examples: joint ventures, cost sharing
- Repeated game table - rows=rounds, cols=strategies, scores - examples: tit-for-tat, cartels

families.name: CONTROL THEORY
entries: - State-space table - rows=states, cols=inputs, dynamics - examples: cruise control, drone attitude
- Gain margin table - rows=frequencies, cols=gains, dB - examples: amplifier design, PID tuning
- Phase margin table - rows=frequencies, cols=phases, degrees - examples: loop stability, servo design
- Bode table - rows=log frequency, cols=magnitude, phase - examples: filters, equalizers
- Nyquist table - rows=real, cols=imaginary, encirclements - examples: stability margins, oscillators
- Setpoint table - rows=operating points, cols=setpoints, outputs - examples: thermostats, chemical reactors
- Observability table - rows=states, cols=sensors, ranks - examples: kalman design, sensor placement
- Controllability table - rows=states, cols=actuators, ranks - examples: actuator sizing, fault tolerance
